items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Oh, just Eddie and myself, we organized, you know, we got a couple of fellas together.

ctx.x: Oh, just Eddie and myself, we organized, you know, we got a couple of fellas together. You know some of these bands was organized and they last about, the organization would last about two months. But this band lasted longer than that. Oh yeah, that lasted for a couple of years, I think. And we had a woman playing piano with us, her name was, uh, uh, uh, oh, let's see, I can't go on there now.
Well, I could name some woman piano players. Well, name one that might be.
